properties.run_id: active run id or automation id
properties.target: absolute project path or automation target
properties.automation_friction: places where Codex hesitated, repeated work, asked unnecessarily, or missed context
properties.validation_gaps: checks that were missing, flaky, too slow, or discovered late
properties.reviewer_findings: independent reviewer findings and whether they repeated earlier patterns
properties.repeated_failures: recurring failures, tool errors, prompt ambiguity, or project-type blind spots
properties.learning_candidates: count and summary of improvement candidates generated
properties.auto_applied: low or medium risk candidates promoted and validated without user intervention
properties.shadowed: high-risk or insufficient-evidence candidates recorded but not applied
properties.next_run_adjustments: concrete behavior changes for the next autonomous run
